svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 07 · Riverside · 05/12 Botanic Gardens (Uncommon)
svg.desc: Paths wind up into the hills past cactus, agave and sage. Hummingbirds work the flowers. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
